event_summary: A bright circular ground fixture remains stationary while a white plume above it changes shape and spreads over time.
raw_event_description: The video shows a low nighttime view of a round rim set into a dark wet surface. A very bright white area fills the circle, and a translucent white plume is already rising above it at the start. The plume curls upward in tall, narrow folds, then becomes thicker and more opaque around the circle. Later it spreads outward, especially toward the right side, forming a broader low cloud while the bright circular area remains visible beneath it. The surrounding wet surface stays in place and reflects orange and white light throughout.

reasons: The bright circular area and rim are visible at the start.
The white plume is already present and changing at the start.
The very bright center obscures interior detail.
The dark surrounding scene limits background visibility.
